**Coaching Note:**

Your knight on d4 looked trapped, but that distracted you from a bigger opportunity. After Black played Bg7, that bishop became undefended. Your rook can capture on a7 with check, and after the king moves, Black's bishop on g7 hangs completely. Always scan for undefended pieces—especially ones that look busy attacking your pieces. A free piece beats any hanging knight.
